newsitem.title: UK: ScotPower appoints head of power, water.
newsitem.headline: ScotPower appoints head of power, water.

text.p: British multi-utility Scottish Power Plc said it had appointed Mike Kinski as chief executive of its division covering power distribution and water operations.
Kinski will have responsibility for Southern Water, the water company bought last year, and its regional electricity company (Rec) Manweb.
He will become chairman as well as chief executive of both Southern Water and Manweb, the company said in a statement.
Finance director Ian Russell becomes chairman of ScottishTelecom.
"I believe that the changes in board responsibilities announced today will strengthen Scottish Power's position as one of the UK's leading multi-utility companies," chief executive Ian Robinson said.
